title: conduct.chat
tagline: AI workflow orchestrator: natural language → multi-agent blockchain execution with smart contracts
description:
conduct.chat is a revolutionary AI workflow orchestration platform that transforms natural language prompts into executable multi-agent blockchain workflows. The platform combines a sophisticated orchestrator with a decentralized agent marketplace, enabling users to create complex blockchain operations through simple conversational interfaces.

At its core, conduct.chat features:

🤖 AI Orchestrator: Converts natural language descriptions like "Create a Naruto NFT collection and deploy it to Ethereum" into structured workflows with appropriate agent selection, task sequencing, and execution planning.

🔗 Blockchain-Native Agent Registry: A comprehensive smart contract system managing agent registration, reputation tracking, and payment escrow. Agents can be HTTP endpoints, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, or blockchain-native smart contracts.

⚡ Multi-Agent Execution Engine: Coordinates complex workflows involving image generation (DALL-E 3), NFT deployment, DeFi operations (Aave, 1inch), metadata creation, and cross-chain operations with real-time status tracking and error handling.

💎 Decentralized Reputation System: On-chain reputation scoring based on task completion rates, user ratings, and response times, ensuring quality and reliability in the agent ecosystem.

🎨 Intuitive Frontend: A beautiful, neobrutalist-designed interface that makes complex blockchain operations accessible to non-technical users while providing detailed execution logs and results for developers.

The platform addresses the critical gap between AI capabilities and blockchain execution, making Web3 operations as simple as having a conversation while maintaining the security, transparency, and decentralization that blockchain technology provides.
